senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) righteousness, justice, equity; virtue.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 907:8">Yalk. Deut. 907</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 16:9">Deut. XVI, 9</cite>) <he>אין יוצא ידי עולמו עד שיורה צ׳ בהוראתו</he> he (that takes bribes) will not finish his days before he will prove that his (wrong) decision was right; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 144:11">Sifré Deut. 144</cite> <he>עד שיורוהו</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 58:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. LVIII</cite> ed. Bub. <he>ולא הודה בצִדְקוֹ של דוד</he> he would not confess that David was right.
Ib. בצ׳ רדפתם אחרי did you pursue me justly? או בצ׳ שפטתם אותי or did you judge me in righteousness?; a. fr.—מְשִׁיחַ צֶ׳ the true Messiah (Jer. XXIII, 6).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 37:1">Pesik. R. s. 37</cite> <he>אפרים מ׳ צִדְקִי</he> Ephraim, my (the Lord’s) true Messiah.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 37:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ צִדְקֵינוּ</he> our true Messiah; a. fr.
Ib. 156ᵇ top דקאי צ׳ במערב because Ts. stands in the west (thy planet is declining).
Gen. R. s. 43 (ref. to Is. XLI, 2) מזל צ׳ היה מאיר לו the planet Ts. shone on his (Abraham’s) way; a. fr.
